title: Exhaustion, Expiry and Client Cancellation of a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Program
content:
# Program Terms — How a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Program Ends

## Clause 1. Exhaustion

A Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs program becomes exhausted on the day its last unit is used.

## Clause 2. Expiry

2.1 A program expires only when the handling date is later than the expiry counted from its purchase date.

2.2 The expiry is the pack's unit validity in months after the purchase date — or after the last top-up, where the pack's top-up resets the expiry date — plus the pack's expiry grace in calendar days, a date missing from a short month falling on that month's last day.

2.3 Unused units lapse on expiry.

2.4 The comparison is strict: on the last day of the grace the program has not yet expired; it expires on any handling date after that day.

### Worked boundary, on hypothetical figures

Purchase date 2026-01-15, a hypothetical validity of 12 months, no top-up, and a hypothetical grace of 15 calendar days. Twelve months after the purchase date is 2027-01-15; 15 calendar days after that is 2027-01-30.

| Handling date | Later than 2027-01-30? | Program expired? |
|---|---|---|
| 2027-01-29 | No | No |
| 2027-01-30 | No — the same day | No |
| 2027-01-31 | Yes | Yes; unused units lapse |

Where the same pack's top-up resets the expiry date and the last top-up was on a hypothetical 2026-06-01, the months are counted from 2026-06-01 instead: 2027-06-01, plus 15 calendar days, gives 2027-06-16.

## Clause 3. Cancellation by the client

3.1 The client may cancel an active program at any time.

3.2 When the client cancels within the pack's refund window, in calendar days after purchase, it is refunded the pack's refund percentage of the price of the unused purchased units. Bonus units and rolled-in units are never refunded. Otherwise nothing is refunded.

3.3 Unused units lapse on cancellation.

| Cancellation | Refund |
|---|---|
| within the refund window after purchase | the refund percentage of the price of the unused purchased units |
| after the refund window | nothing |
| of bonus units or rolled-in units, at any time | never refunded |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a client cancels well inside a pack's refund window with 40 unused purchased units at a hypothetical unit price of 10.00 USD and a hypothetical refund percentage of 50. The price of the unused purchased units is 400.00 USD (40 multiplied by 10.00), and the refund is 50 percent of it, 200.00 USD. Any unused bonus or rolled-in units add nothing. Had the same client cancelled after the refund window, nothing would be refunded.

## Clause 4. Running series

Series already running when a program expires or is cancelled are completed.

## Points of judgement

**Is a program on the last day of its grace still open?** Yes. It expires only on a handling date later than the expiry plus grace.

**What happens to a debtor's letters when the program ends mid-series?** The series already running is completed.
